attack: a hand-typed block whose numbers are TRUE (the one forgery the gate cannot and should not catch)
why: the honest boundary of provenance: a true block typed by hand is indistinguishable; the matrix must say so instead of claiming 100% detection
wouldBeWrongIf: the gate CATCHES it (then the 'neutralized' claim is false and the vector is masked), or the claimed/ recomputed readings disagree (then it is not actually true)

expects.neutralizedWhy: the block is a true statement about a real corpus: no provenance check can tell it from all.mjs output, and refusing it would refuse honest reports too. Recorded as a known boundary, not a win.
